title.rendered: Juventus Kit 2025-26 For Dream League Soccer 2026

content.rendered:
Copy URL of  Juventus kits season 2025 – 26 for Dream League Soccer 2026 – DLS 26 with complete Home, Away and Third kits, Goal keeper kit was also included, can also be used in FTS games.

Features Of Juventus Kits

  • Neck EQT with three stripes.
  • White base
  • Jeep logo.
  • Single and double centered cane.
  • Whites socks.
  • White shorts with black pattern of colors.

Juventus Home Kits

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/i2JngBq.png

 

Away Juventus DLS Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/33v1W1V.png

Juventus Third Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/2SaAvo6.png

 

Juventus Goal Keeper Home Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/XPFDNXi.png

Juventus Goal Keeper Away DLS Kit

Copy Kit URL: https://i.imgur.com/zSRSSJB.png

 

 

 

Juventus Logo
